title: Tuscan Vegetable Bread Pie
subtitle: with ricotta and Parmesan
description: A Tuscan-style savoury pie with a base of sliced bread, topped with sauteed vegetables and an egg, ricotta and Parmesan custard. Serve at room temperature.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Grease a baking tin and line it with baking paper.
Lay a single layer of sliced bread (3 cm thick, crust on) in the tin as a base.
Blanch the green beans in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, drain and halve crosswise.
Heat a frying pan with 2 tbsp olive oil and sauté the zucchini ribbons and diced capsicum for about 2 minutes. Add the blanched beans and take off the heat.

Whisk the eggs with salt, pepper and parsley, then mix in the ricotta and 1 tbsp Parmesan. Pour over the bread in the tin. Arrange the sauteed vegetables on top and sprinkle with a handful of Parmesan.
Reduce the oven to 180°C and bake for 20 minutes until the pie is set and golden. Cool and serve at room temperature.
